assumptions: GEOID S1GRD tiles are linear sigma0 at 10 m with about 4.4 equivalent looks.
Mapped background in the CEMS-derived label is not confirmed dry land.
The development tiles are representative enough of the test tiles to choose on.
confidence: low: a research benchmark on one foreign event; the development score is agreement with a same-pass CEMS map, not independent accuracy

development.wording: agreement with a same-pass CEMS map, not independent accuracy

land_cover_stratification: none: no land-cover layer for these tiles is on disk
otsu_comparator: same parameters with threshold_method otsu; reported, never selected
selection_rule: Pooled development IoU on the primary comparison, with every abstained cell counted as 'not a candidate' (strict reading), for the Kittler-Illingworth threshold.
slope_mask: none: no DEM for these tiles is on disk (plan A3)
